parole.significato: To shut up, as in a desk; to treasure.
parole.testo: From Middle English deske, desque, from Medieval Latin desca, modified from Old Italian desco, from Latin discus. Doublet of dais, disc, discus, dish, disk, and diskos. See also German Tisch, "table".

parole.significato: Any of the large, hairy New World spiders comprising the family Theraphosidae.
